summary_en: GMO Internet Group will cancel 17,122,619 treasury shares (15.95% of outstanding shares before cancellation) effective November 11, 2026. After cancellation, outstanding shares will total 90,226,502. This accelerates the company's long-term goal to retire approximately 38.35 million shares issued during 2006-2007 capital increases.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares (Cancellation of Treasury Shares Based on the Provisions of Article 178 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: On November 2, 2026, GMO Internet Group's board of directors resolved to cancel 17,122,619 treasury shares, representing 15.95% of outstanding shares before cancellation. The cancellation will become effective on November 11, 2026, reducing total outstanding shares to 90,226,502. The company holds these shares following completion of a 30 billion yen share buyback program authorized on June 19, 2026. The company originally planned to cancel treasury shares equivalent to 17% of parent company net income sequentially; however, upon completion of the acquisition program, management decided to accelerate cancellation of all held treasury shares to advance the company's long-term objective. Since 2006-2007, the company has undertaken a multi-year program to retire approximately 38.35 million shares that were issued during capital increases accompanying the exit from its loan credit business. As of this cancellation, the company will have acquired approximately 28.62 million shares (74.6% of target) and retired approximately 27.58 million shares (71.9% of target). The company intends to continue this long-term program to achieve full retirement of the targeted share count.
